Triage: first-touch graded — promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `bug` + `documentation`. (Triage seat, session `session_0185aJyu6TRnHbcVgSfGPSho`.)

Rationale: published docs (three sites, including `content/docs/plugins/index.md`) teach an `api` data provider for plugin-calendar that is measured to be a `console.warn` stub — an author following the docs ships a silently empty surface. Same defect class as #5163 (plugin-map), which is why the fix may be bundled with #5163 into one claim **if** that card is still undispatched; otherwise keep separate and name it as a sibling.

⛔ Scope guard, carried from the card and binding on dispatch: the **gantt** copy of the identical sentence is TRUE (its `api` provider is implemented) — this is a shared sentence, not a shared defect. No grep-and-replace sweep; fix the three calendar sites only, and re-measure per plugin on the current ref before touching anything. Whether calendar's `api` provider should be *implemented* is capability expansion — explicitly out of scope here, same line #5163 drew.

Serial constraints cleared: nothing open touches plugin-calendar or `content/docs/plugins/**`. **PR5251 merged this round** and touched `content/docs/blocks/forms.mdx` — a different file; rebase anyway.

## Bundling is OFF — and that changes what you have

Triage wrote: *"the fix may be bundled with #5163 into one claim **if** that card is still undispatched; otherwise keep separate and name it as a sibling."*

I checked: **#5163 is closed**, delivered by **PR5181** (`fix(plugin-map): correct residual "object/api/value" claim to "object/value"`), merged today at 10:01Z. So this card stands alone — and you have something better than a bundle: **a merged reference implementation of this exact fix, one plugin over.** Read PR5181 before you start. Match its shape and its wording choice unless you have a measured reason not to, and say so if you deviate.

## ⛔ The trap — the sentence is shared, the defect is not

The identical sentence (*"Works with object/api/value data providers"*) is published for **three** plugins. For **gantt it is TRUE** — its `api` provider is genuinely implemented (`ObjectGantt.tsx:442`, `:445`, `:1155`).

**A grep-and-replace over `object/api/value` would silently make the gantt documentation wrong** — turning a documentation fix into a documentation defect, in a file this card does not own.

⛔ Do not sweep. ⛔ Do not touch gantt. **Re-measure per plugin against the current ref** before changing a character, and state in your report what you measured for each of the three plugins that carry the sentence — including gantt, precisely to show you checked and left it alone.

This is the card's own most important content, and it is why the card exists as a finding rather than a one-line patch.

## Premise — re-verify; the anchors are from `072085de`

The card measured three calendar sites:

```
content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx:178   - **ObjectQL Integration**: Works seamlessly with object/api/value data providers
packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx:22   * - Works with object/api/value data providers
content/docs/plugins/index.md:168              - Works with object/api/value providers   (Calendar Plugin section)
```

against the actual branch:

```
packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx:294-295
  } else if (dataConfig?.provider === 'api') {
    console.warn('API provider not yet implemented for ObjectCalendar');
```

Note the **third site is one plugin-map did not have** (`content/docs/plugins/index.md`), so PR5181's file list is not a template for yours — only its wording is. Take all anchors from the tree; a dozen PRs have landed since this card was filed.

## Scope — the line this card and #5163 both draw

⛔ **Whether calendar's `api` provider should be *implemented* is capability expansion and is explicitly out of scope.** Both this card and #5163's triage drew that line. If you find yourself in `ObjectCalendar.tsx`'s data-loading branch doing anything other than reading it, stop.

The only source change is the **file-header JSDoc comment**. No runtime behaviour changes. If your diff to `ObjectCalendar.tsx` is anything other than a comment line, you have left the card.

## Tests

There is nothing to unit-test in a prose correction, and ⛔ do not invent a test that greps for a sentence — that is the sweep this card forbids, wearing a test's clothes.

The verification is the **measurement**: for each of the three plugins carrying the sentence, show the claim site(s) and the corresponding provider branch, and state TRUE or FALSE with the evidence. That table is the deliverable's proof.

If a gate covers `content/docs/plugins/**` (check — `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-component-types`, `Build Docs` at minimum), run it and report. If none covers the claim itself, say so plainly rather than implying coverage.

## Gates

Derive from your diff. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is **objectstack-only**. Expect `Internal Docs Link Check`, `Doc Component Type Check`, `Build Docs`, `Control Byte Scan`. Changeset: `packages/plugin-calendar/src/**` is inside a published package, so **run `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and follow its verdict** — a header comment may or may not owe one, and PR5181 is your precedent for what the gate said about the equivalent map change. ⛔ never `major`.

⛔ **Do not background a long check and end your turn.**

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first body line `Fixes #5180`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report and post it as a comment whose first line is the literal `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker.
